title: Intraday Liquidity and Dealer Bank Failure Mechanics

maps.tested: Reading 71 rated Important; Reading 73 unrated by the sheet but is the natural home of the Northern Rock / Bear Stearns run dynamics.
maps.specifics: Intraday liquidity monitoring tools and the payment-system angle; for dealer banks, the runs on repo, on prime-brokerage balances, and on OTC derivatives counterparties. Case-lesson matching against Northern Rock is the likely format.

vardeezReading: LTR-6: Important. "Explain the uses and sources of intraday liquidity." LTR-8: Important. "One question might come up from dealer banks. So know it well, maybe go through crash course notes and that would be it." LTR-1: Important (his pointers there are LVaR calculation and liquidity black holes; the funding-risk cases of LTR-1 b carry no pointer).

los.vardeez: Uses and sources of intraday liquidity

selectors.name: Intraday monitoring: flow measures versus risk-level measures
selectors.what: Sorting intraday liquidity measures into those that track flows (total payments, settlement positions at each FMU, time-sensitive obligations, credit lines extended to clients and available to the bank) and those that monitor risk levels (daily maximum intraday liquidity usage, intraday credit relative to Tier 1 capital, client intraday credit usage, payment throughput by time of day); also the intraday stress-test scenario categories.

selectors.name: Payment-system angle: intraday uses and sources
selectors.what: Uses of intraday liquidity (outgoing wires, the largest use; PCS settlement; nostro funding; collateral pledging; asset purchases) against sources (central bank and correspondent balances; incoming funds flow, the largest source in normal markets; intraday credit; liquid assets; overnight and term funding), plus daylight overdraft policy (Fed net debit cap and fees, Bank of England collateralised and free credit) and FMU defences and tools.

selectors.name: Dealer-bank runs: repo, prime brokerage, OTC derivatives
selectors.what: The three runs on a weakening dealer bank (short-term secured creditors not renewing repo, prime brokerage clients withdrawing cash and securities, derivatives counterparties cutting exposure or collecting collateral on downgrade), the final step of the clearing bank invoking its right of offset, and the mitigants and policy responses.

selectors.name: Case-lesson matching, Northern Rock and others
selectors.what: Matching each failure case to its lesson: Northern Rock (short-term wholesale funding, a retail run triggered by news of central bank support, liquidity is not solvency), Bear Stearns, Lehman, AIG, Ashanti Goldfields and Metallgesellschaft (margin calls on hedges of illiquid positions).

notSelected: LTR-6 b (governance of intraday liquidity risk, three lines of defence), LTR-8 a (lines of business of dealer banks and their risks) and LTR-8 c (policy measures for dealer banks, beyond the mitigants named inside the runs) carry no shape, no Map point and no Vardeez pointer.
